patterns: Genuine APPSC sociology items here are scenario-based: identify consanguineous vs affinal pairs in a family vignette (APPSC 2025).
Most PYQs filed here are blood-relation reasoning puzzles, not kinship sociology.
Expect direct term-meaning items (lineage vs clan, avunculate vs amitate, teknonymy) and North-South contrast (cross-cousin marriage, menarikam).
App MCQs go deeper into scholars (Morgan, Dumont, Kolenda) and descent typologies than APPSC has shown.
